coffee_routes.title: Coffee, with a handover.
coffee_routes.result: You show the first refill. The intern makes the next pot without summoning Chief. The policy stack keeps a ring off the desk.

coffee_routes.title: A clear rule. A cold pot.
coffee_routes.result: The newcomer can read the notice but cannot use the machine. The instruction survives; the refill waits for help.

coffee_routes.title: Register closed. Kettle open.
coffee_routes.result: You retire the signed cup history and make the refill with the intern. The next person has a task instead of a clearance process.

coffee_routes.title: Fully compliant. Still empty.
coffee_routes.result: Every signature is accounted for. Chief signs the audit. The coffee is still absent, but its absence is now impeccably documented.

coffee_routes.title: One duty returns.
coffee_routes.result: You make the first refill and put the sentence by the kettle. The intern takes the next last cup and starts another pot. Chief keeps the wall free of appendices.

coffee_routes.title: The pot awaits a volunteer.
coffee_routes.result: Everyone leaves space for someone else to act. The pot stays empty. The fan completes another revolution without volunteering.
